# CRM Integration Specialists

> CRM Integration Specialists, led by Ammar Hussain, engineers custom bi-directional API bridges between GoHighLevel, Clio, Lawmatics, Filevine, Salesforce, Zoho, and CasePeer, plus Retell AI voice agent workflows, for law firms and GHL agencies.

Every integration is built on real-time, webhook-driven sync with sub-380ms latency, 100% field-mapping accuracy, conflict resolution logic, and dead-letter retry queues built into dedicated middleware (n8n & Node.js).

## Core Services

- [Bi-Directional Legal CRM & GoHighLevel Sync](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/ghl-clio-integration): Real-time, two-way data sync between GoHighLevel and legal CRMs like Clio, Lawmatics, and Filevine.
- [AI Voice Agent CRM Integration](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/retell-ai-crm-integration): Retell AI voice agents wired directly into CRM systems for live call logging, transcript extraction, and post-call workflow automation.
- [Custom API & Webhook Middleware](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/#services): Purpose-built middleware for payload validation, schema transformation, OAuth token refresh, and dead-letter handling.
- [Technical Integration Blog & Guides](https://www.crmintegrationspecialist.com/blog): Deep-dives into webhook architecture, API sync patterns, and legal automation.
